name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 31) — Windows 11 design, native on ARM64.
• Windows 11 look throughout: Windows 11 colours and your accent colour, rounded controls, Windows 11 check boxes, lists, menus, tooltips and tabs, Settings laid out like Windows Settings. Dark mode fixed in every window.
• Snap layouts from the maximize button. Mica window background on Windows 11 PCs (Settings → General → Window background).
• Native on ARM64 PCs (e.g. Windows on Apple Silicon): the installer picks the right version and can install the ARM64 .NET 8 Desktop Runtime for you.
• Includes the Word add-in fixes of builds 27–30.
